tasks.label: Test project form and sidebar
tasks.command: & { $env:DATABASE_BACKEND='sqlite'; $env:PYTHONUTF8='1'; & '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -m pytest -c '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/pytest.ini' '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/platform_api/tests/test_project_outputs.py' '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/platform_api/tests/test_layout_names.py' -k 'project_admin_columns or dashboard_layout_explorer or dashboard_alias or active_toggle' --tb=short; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }

tasks.label: Verify map lines (production)
tasks.command: & { $previous = $env:BUYER_TEST_BUILD; try { $env:BUYER_TEST_BUILD=''; npm --prefix '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/frontend' run test:e2e -- --grep 'schematic lines'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm --prefix '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/frontend' run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:BUYER_TEST_BUILD='preview'; npm --prefix '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/frontend' run test:e2e; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('BUYER_TEST_BUILD', $previous, 'Process') } }

tasks.label: Test admin queues and processing catalogue
tasks.command: & { $names=@('DATABASE_BACKEND','PROJECT_METRO_CATALOGUE_FILE','PYTHONUTF8'); $previous=@{}; foreach($name in $names) { $previous[$name]=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name,'Process') }; try { $env:DATABASE_BACKEND='sqlite'; $env:PROJECT_METRO_CATALOGUE_FILE=''; $env:PYTHONUTF8='1'; & '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -m pytest -c '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/pytest.ini' '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/platform_api/tests/test_admin_navigation.py' '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/platform_api/tests/test_external_sources.py' '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/backend/platform_api/tests/test_api.py' -k 'navigation or saved_location_leaves or direct_location_draft or map_preview or processing_catalogue' --tb=short; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Focused tests failed.' } } finally { foreach($name in $names) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name,$previous[$name],'Process') } } }

tasks.label: Test project gallery (production)
tasks.command: & { $previous = $env:BUYER_TEST_BUILD; try { npm --prefix '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/frontend' run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:BUYER_TEST_BUILD='preview'; npm --prefix '${workspaceFolder}/reailEstate/frontend' run test:e2e -- --grep 'project gallery'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('BUYER_TEST_BUILD', $previous, 'Process') } }
